status: exploratory development after original, leg, modular and diagnostic results were inspected
reference: unchanged paired-image expert consensus, back1-4 arms1-3 legs2/3/4/5/7 load fixed1
main_validation: same five outer and three inner GroupKFold splits as modular_v1; recording plus floor(seconds/60); <=10-second training purge; train-only preprocessing
sensitivity: repeat all systems with 30-second grouping; retain 60 seconds as principal analysis
recording_transfer: both directions, same worker, source-only selection; not new-person validation or causal clothing effect
v1_reuse: immutable cached inner predictions and scores and selected outer predictions reused only when exact source hashes and split identities match; otherwise old candidate is refit with identical code/settings on the identical training rows

experiment1.features_augmented: generic74 plus deterministic torso38/view, total112/view224paired; 2D projections only, not true twist or force measurement
experiment1.availability: identical original generic pose flags, paired OR; torso feature validity does not tighten the gate
experiment1.other_components: exact same cached modular_v1 primary arms and legs in both systems
experiment1.selection: mean inner-fold fixed-class back macro-F1, ties first candidate

experiment2.embedding_preprocessing: training StandardScaler -> full-SVD PCA whiten=false with min(16,n_train-1,embedding_width) TOTAL components -> training StandardScaler -> divide by sqrt(component_count)
experiment2.pose_preprocessing: generic74 plus binary pose-detected flag per view; training median imputer(add_indicator=true,keep_empty_features=true) -> training StandardScaler -> divide by sqrt(transformed_pose_width)
experiment2.input_order: embeddings front then side; pose+flag front then side
experiment2.matching: identical embedding preprocessing, views, C grid, training rows and selection; only fusion adds the pose block
experiment2.availability: all finite image embeddings available, regardless of pose; all181 retained
experiment2.selection: mean inner-fold fixed-class component macro-F1; ties side then front then paired, C0.1 before1
experiment2.interpretation: PCA does not guarantee removal of background, clothing or person information; margins are not calibrated confidence

experiment3.views: paired only for both alternatives of every component
experiment3.A_back: generic+torso RF, depth5/None selected by inner back macro-F1
experiment3.A_arms: genericpose RF, depth5/None selected by inner arms macro-F1
experiment3.A_legs: genericpose+leggeometry RF, depth5/None selected by inner legs macro-F1
experiment3.B_each_component: embeddingPCA+pose LinearSVC, C0.1/1 selected by inner component macro-F1
experiment3.head_selection: choose A or B independently by mean inner-fold component macro-F1; ties A
experiment3.joint_selection: evaluate same eight A/B triples using mean of INNER-FOLD full-code accuracies, all inner validation rows including unresolved; maximize, tie higher mean component macro-F1, then lexicographic A-before-B triple
experiment3.matching: exact same candidate predictors, parameters, inner predictions and outer fitted model outputs; only selection objective differs
experiment3.rare_class_and_action_errors: reported separately; no hidden test-driven constraints or weights

endpoint: exact complete OWAS code on all181 including unresolved; load fixed1
frozen_external_status: original modular_v1 primary remains unchanged; all v2 systems may be frozen as secondary candidates before new-worker labels are seen; no new primary chosen from these development rankings
limitations: one worker, two recordings, repeated adaptive reuse, purposive irregular frames; all results exploratory, no population CI/p-values/superiority claim, no new-worker result or fresh-raw-image parity claim
